impact_assessment.mitigation: Scheduler tests fail without the change; default behaviour (quick then full continue) is untouched and still tested.

impact_assessment.why: A full tune asks up to about 10000 answers and generation is 92 to 93 percent of its time; profiling showed no waste to remove without changing results, so the lever is not running the whole tune.
